summary: Quantify climate risks to public budgets, assets and contingent liabilities. Build a practical climate fiscal risk assessment in 5 days. Enrol now.
lede: Climate fiscal risk assessment estimates how climate hazards may affect public budgets, assets and contingent liabilities. For treasury analysts, public investment managers and fiscal risk teams, the course covers mapping asset exposure, estimating damage and fiscal costs, screening investment proposals, and incorporating findings into budget planning and climate fiscal risk statements.
audienceIntro: This course is built for the people who have to produce, defend and use climate fiscal risk numbers inside a real budget process, not for general climate awareness audiences.
modules: Climate Hazards and Public Fiscal Exposure
Hazard Data and Asset Exposure Mapping
Damage, Loss and Expected Annual Cost Estimation
Disaster Risk Financing and Risk Layering
Climate Screening in Public Investment Appraisal
Fiscal Risk Statements and Budget Integration
prerequisites: You should bring working familiarity with public budgeting, fiscal risk analysis or public investment appraisal, plus comfort using spreadsheets for pivot tables and basic formulas. No coding, GIS or catastrophe modelling experience is required, and no prior climate science background is assumed. Bring a laptop. Where permitted, bring an extract of your own asset register, public investment pipeline or fiscal risk statement so exercises can run on your institution's data; anonymised sample datasets are used otherwise.
